chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Eddie Heywood Sr. and the young Eddie Heywood
summary: JCH says the Eddie Heywood he knew in Atlanta was the father; he first saw the son at about nine in New York.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: With Eddie Heywood's father? What was his name?
Oh, so the Eddie Heywood that we know is a junior?
Was Eddie Heywood's father older than you?
And Eddie Heywood Jr. is younger than you?

The first time I saw Eddie Heywood he was living on the West Side. He was about 9 years old. He wasn't even playing. He was living on the West Side. I met him once and didn't see him any more until I came to New York.
